<module id="edge_detect">
    <description>Detects rising and falling edges of the input signal 'a' and outputs corresponding signals 'rise' and 'down'. The module captures the previous value of 'a' and compares it with the current value to determine if an edge has occurred. It also includes a reset mechanism to initialize the stored values.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="a">Input signal.</input>
        <output id="rise">Output signal indicating a rising edge.</output>
        <output id="down">Output signal indicating a falling edge.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            // Check if reset signal is active
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Initialize previous_a and current_a to 0 on reset
                prev_a <= 1'b0;
                current_a <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                // Update previous_a with current_a
                prev_a <= current_a;
                // Capture the current value of a
                current_a <= a;
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block to detect rising and falling edges
        always @(*) begin
            // Default assignments
            rise = 1'b0;
            down = 1'b0;
            
            // Detect rising edge
            if ((prev_a == 1'b0) && (current_a == 1'b1)) begin
                rise = 1'b1;
            end
            
            // Detect falling edge
            if ((prev_a == 1'b1) && (current_a == 1'b0)) begin
                down = 1'b1;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
